title: Geologic map of the Richtex quadrangle, Richland and Fairfield Counties, South Carolina
citation: Secor, D.T., Jr., and Howard, C.S., 2016, Geologic map of the Richtex quadrangle, Richland and Fairfield Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 222, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face and correlation chart garbled; publication number prints as 'XXXXX'. A stray OCR line labels the Little Mountain text as the quartz crystal metatuff; not used. Symbols garbled for Emory, felsic lapilli metatuff ('Zpiti'), Little Mountain ('zime'), quartz crystal metatuff; 'Toc' read as TQc, '309 +/- | Ma' and 'typically | - 10 mm' read with 1 (OCR rule, review). Faults, folds, foliation/lineation, sample sites and the Chappells shear zone boundary symbol known only from the legend not recorded (shear zone recorded from the unit text). No reference list on the sheet.
SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (p.1) has FEET (4000 to -4000) and METERS scales, SEA LEVEL datum, no vertical exaggeration; only the Winnsboro Quartz Monzonite label is legible on it; end locations not stated. Felsic gneiss and amphibolite thought to lie in the immediate subsurface at the NW end. Colluvium from about 320' to 190' (no datum). Map vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum).
